name: kodflow-hud
description: Optional heads-up display beside the status line, as a mod (function hooks, Claude Code 2.1.293 or later): a Tasks pane with the open epics of kodflow-hooks' task list as a tree (subtasks, blockers, the critical path, the worker, model and effort on each task, the time since it last moved, a silent flag, the tasks waiting on the person) or as a graph by state, driven by keys and clicks; an Agents pane with the folder each agent works in and the files it last read, wrote or committed; toasts for a task done, blocked or gone silent. It reads and observes only: no tool, no refusal, nothing added to what the model reads.

silentMinutes.title: Silent after (minutes)
silentMinutes.description: A task in progress with no activity from its worker for this long is flagged silent and toasted once.

autoOpen.title: Open the panes at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Tasks and Agents panes when a session starts. The engine seats an unasked pane only from 144 columns; /hud opens them at any width.

ci.title: CI of cited pull requests
ci.description: Every 5 minutes at most, ask gh pr checks about the GitHub pull request URLs that an open task cites, and show the result beside the task.
